decisions.title: deletePalette only clamps the active index, so deleting a palette before the active one jumps to auto-history
decisions.reason: The deletePalette body in the patch only removes the palette and clamps activePaletteIndex when it is out of range. If the active palette is after the deleted palette, its index is no longer valid: e.g. [auto,A,B] with B active (index 2), deleting A leaves [auto,B] (count 2), and `2 >= 2` resets activePaletteIndex to 0, selecting auto-history instead of B. If the active palette is still within range, the index is also not decremented, so it silently points to a different palette. The patch does not contain any decrement or restoreAutoHistorySelection call in deletePalette, so the reported failure follows from the changed code.
